name: YIT Oyj
summary: YIT Oyj provides construction services in Finland, Estonia, Lithuania, Latvia, Czechia, Slovakia, and Poland. It operates through four segments: Residential Finland, Residential CEE, Building Construction, and Infrastructure. The company develops and constructs apartments, residential areas, apartments and living services, business premises, and entire areas. It also constructs and renovates projects for industrial buildings, data centers, logistics, retail, sports, hotel, business, and office projects as well as public buildings, such as hospitals, health and well-being centers, day care centers, schools, and multi-purpose buildings.
